semiconductor_relevance: High — Polyteknik AS specializes in PVD equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, making it a relevant supplier in the industry.
summary: Polyteknik AS is a leading manufacturer of PVD systems designed for production and R&D in the semiconductor, MEMS, and electronic industries. With over 25 years of experience, they offer a range of deposition technologies including sputtering and thermal evaporation, catering to both small-scale and high-volume production needs.
capabilities: High-quality PVD systems for DC/RF/HIPIMS sputtering
E-beam deposition and thermal evaporation systems
FLEXTURA PVD systems for flexible and robust industrial production
Glancing Angle Deposition (GLAD) for up to 200mm substrates
